A '''[[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Species/Legends|species]]''' found within [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] on [[Planet/Legends|planets]] like [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="AOTC" /> A member of this species was one of the [[Four Masters/Legends|Four Masters]].<ref name="CL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref>

==Biology and appearance==
A [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]], they possessed [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] features, with pointed [[Ear/Legends|ears]].<ref name="AOTC" />

==Species in the galaxy==
One member of this species served as one of the [[Four Masters/Legends|Four Masters]], legendary [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] who founded the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] around [[4000 BBY/Legends|4,000 years]] before the [[Declaration of a New Order|rise]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="CL" />

==Behind the scenes==
This species could first be seen briefly via a statue in the background of {{Film|III}},<ref name="AOTC" /> later shown better in sources like the guide for the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' episode [[Sabotage (episode)|Sabotage]].<ref name="Sabotage">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/sabotage-episode-guide|text="Sabotage" Episode Guide &#124; The Clone Wars}}</ref>
